svg.title: 閒 the gap — artbitrage.io
svg.desc: A door in two leaves. The gap between them opens into a full round moon and closes again: the moon is not drawn, it is the gap, and whatever is behind the door shows through. 閒 (門 + 月, 隙也): moonlight seen through the gap of a door, the first way 間 was written. artbitrage.io, a place to meet art.
